claim: No arrangement of 12 distinct affine straight lines with exactly one parallel pair and no finite multiple point has 39 triangular bounded faces.

scope.straight_line_soundness: Each CNF is a necessary-condition relaxation; UNSAT covers every real arrangement in this branch.

normalization.parallel_pair_canonicalization: Rotate the projective slope circle so the unique parallel direction is first, then relabel its two lines 0 and 1.
normalization.compact_symmetry_justification: P(0,2), P(0,3), P(2,3) are fixed true and C(0,2,3) false. The affine involution b_i -> -b_i preserves slopes, parallels, concurrencies and triangular faces while flipping every strict crossing-order bit. The primary certificate does not use this clause; the independent compact certificate does.

generator.direct_gap_criterion: A selected triple is a triangular face only if no outside crossing lies strictly between its two vertices on any side line.
generator.reproduction: Current generator reproduces both CNFs byte-for-byte (cmp exit 0).

consequence: Blanc's exact simple maximum a_3^s(12)=37 excludes the Q=0/no-concurrency branch. Therefore every hypothetical 12-line arrangement with 39 triangular faces must contain a finite multiple point. These certificates alone do not prove K(12)=38.
